final: WITH per_event AS (SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count FROM attendance GROUP BY link_to_event), ranked AS (SELECT event_id, attendance_count, attendance_count * 1.0 / SUM(attendance_count) OVER () AS share, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY attendance_count DESC) AS event_rank FROM per_event) SELECT event_id, attendance_count, share FROM ranked WHERE event_rank <= 10 ORDER BY share IS NULL, share DESC, event_id
